verdict.rationale: Trademark filers can check status in the Trademark Status and Document Retrieval (TSDR) system, where new applications appear in the documents tab. Public pages also offer average wait times per stage, a Decisions and Proceedings search tool, and trademark database search. However, tracking patent application progress is explicitly limited to registered, logged-in users, and the Trademark Center docketing feature sits behind an MFA account wall. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that TSDR is usable without login, public status lookup for patent applications, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a public status lookup.
